# The Growth Path

> An educational resource for parents worried about their son's height, growth pattern, and puberty timing. Data-driven guides, free calculators, and a plain-language glossary. Not medical advice.

The Growth Path is for parents (particularly mothers) of boys ages 8-14 who are concerned about their child's height. Our content is grounded in guidance from the CDC, the American Academy of Pediatrics, the Endocrine Society, and peer-reviewed pediatric endocrinology literature.

We do not sell supplements. We do not promise added height. We do not diagnose. We organize the information a parent needs to prepare for a pediatrician conversation about growth.

## Key resources

- [Growth Check](https://www.thegrowthpath.app/growth-check/) — Free tool that plots current CDC percentile alongside the mid-parental height prediction
- [Family Height Calculator](https://www.thegrowthpath.app/family-height-calculator/) — Adult height prediction from both parents' heights
- [Height Percentile Calculator](https://www.thegrowthpath.app/height-percentile-calculator/) — Current CDC percentile for a boy's age and height
- [The Waitlist](https://www.thegrowthpath.app/waitlist/) — Sign up for The Growth Path app when it launches

## Foundation reference pages

- [Glossary: 30 pediatric growth terms defined](https://www.thegrowthpath.app/glossary/) — Every term you'll hear at a pediatrician appointment, plain English, sourced
- [FAQ: 30 questions parents ask](https://www.thegrowthpath.app/faq/) — Common parent questions with sourced answers
- [Height percentiles data table for boys, ages 2-18](https://www.thegrowthpath.app/data/height-percentiles-boys/) — Full CDC growth chart in tabular form
